_comment: Sokoban scene config — top-down 2D grid. tick_seconds=0 means 'tick on input only' (turn-based). Cell size = 32px. position_scale=1.0 because we author in pixels.

camera._: Center camera on the bounding box of all floor tiles → frames the level rather than following the player. lerp=1.0 = instant snap (turn-based, no smoothing needed). Updates per-frame so a level transition recenters automatically.
